question: Which first-party Yandex page, or which organization admin screen, states that IMAP, SMTP and POP3 are unavailable to an organization without a Yandex 360 plan from June 29, 2026, and does the cut-off reach non-profit organizations that keep the services free? (unverified: behind a sign-up)
why: Only third-party posts quote the notice (habr.com/ru/news/1042832) and report staged dates, from June 29 to August 3, and that personal mailboxes are unaffected (habr.com/ru/articles/1053602 relays Yandex support); the first-party FAQ says organizations move to paid plans in stages, each emailed 7 days before its first payment, and the help for personal mailboxes still documents IMAP and SMTP with an app password. email/yandex-360 carries the reported fact in limits_note at the reported rung.
